title: Skype Call Ringtone
blurb: Boop-boop-boop-boop-boop. For roughly a decade this was the sound of the internet phoning you, and it still triggers a very specific dread in anybody who endured remote interviews, long-distance relationships or university group projects between 2005 and 2015. Skype's incoming-call tone was relentlessly cheerful in a way that rarely matched the situations it announced. The service has since been wound down entirely, which has only made the tone more potent — it is a genuine period artefact now, filed alongside the dial-up handshake.
